titles.romaji: Trinity Seven Movie - Tenkuu Toshokan to Shinku no Maou
titles.english: Trinity Seven: Heavens Library & Crimson Lord
titles.native: 劇場版トリニティセブン -天空図書館と真紅の魔王

description:
Arata, Lilith and the rest of the Trinity Seven ace off against their greatest enemy; Lilith's own father, who is revealed to be the strongest Demon Lord. He challenges Arata who is now a Demon Lord candidate.

(Source: Anime News Network)
